paite: Mosi leh Aaron makaih a Aigupta gam a pan apawlpawl a pawt a, apai zeldan uh hiải bang ahi.
heading: Aigupta A Pan Moab Tan Zinna
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in apaikhia ua, apai zelnate uh Mosi in agelh a; apaikhiak ua apainate uh hiaite ahi.
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Rameses a pan apawt ua; Paikan Ankuanglui ni zing in Aigupta mi teng muh in hangsantak in Israel suante apawtkhia uhi.
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

paite: Aigupta mite'n ata masapen teng uh TOUPA'N athahsakte avui ua, apathiante uh leng TOUPA'N athukhen khumta hi.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them. Yahweh also executed judgments on their gods.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante Rameses a pan apawt ua, Sukot ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

paite: Sukot a pan apawt ua, gamdai phak tung Etham ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

paite: Etham a pan apawt ua, Baal-zephon bul a Pi-hahiroth lam ah akinung khin ua, Migdol chin ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

paite: Pi-hahiroth chin a pan apawt ua, tuipi apaltan ua, gamdai ah alut uhi. Etham gamdai ah ni thum lam apai ua, Marah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

paite: Marah a pan apawt ua, Elim atung uh. Elim ah tui nak nei sawm-le-nih leh tum sing sawmsagih a-om a; huai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

paite: Elim a pan apawt ua, Tupi San ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

paite: Tuipi San a pan apawt ua, Sin gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

paite: Sin gamdai a pan apawt ua, Dophkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

paite: Dophkah a pan apawt ua, Alush ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

paite: Alush a pan apawt ua, Rephidim ah giahphual asat ua, huai ah mipite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

paite: Rephidim a pan apawt ua, Sinai gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua, Kibroth- hattaavah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan apawt ua, Hazeroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

paite: Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Rithmah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

paite: Rithmah a pan apawt ua, Rimmon-parez ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

paite: Rimmon-parez a pan apawt ua, Libnah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

paite: Libnah a pan apawt ua, Rissah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

paite: Rissah a pan apawt ua, Kehelathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

paite: Kehelathah a pan apawt ua, Shepher tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

paite: Shepher tang a pan apawt ua, Haradah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

paite: Haradah a pan apawt ua, Makheloth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

paite: Makheloth a pan apawt ua, Tahath ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

paite: Tahath a pan apawt ua, Terah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

paite: Terah a pan apawt ua, Mithkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

paite: Mithkah a pan apawt ua, Hashmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

paite: Hashmonah a pan apawt ua, Moseroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

paite: Moseroth a pan in apawt ua, Bene-jaakan ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

paite: Bene-jaakan a pan apawt ua, Hor-hagidgad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

paite: Hor-hagidgad a pan apawt ua, Jotbathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

paite: Jotbathah a pan apawt ua, Abronah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

paite: Abronah a pan apawt ua, Ezion-geber ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

paite: Ezion-geber a pan apawt ua, Zin gamdai ah giahphual asat uh huai tuh Kadesh leng achi uhi.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

paite: Kadesh a pan apawt ua, Edom gam chin a Hor tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in Hor tang ah Siampu Aaron ahohtou a, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt uh akum sawmlina, akha ngana, ani khat ni in huai ah asita hi.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

paite: Aaron Hor tang a asih in kum zakhat sawmnih-le-thum ahi.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

paite: Kanaan mi, Kanaan gam simlam a om Arad kumpipa'n Israel suante ahong pai uh ana za hi.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

paite: Hor tang a pan apawt ua, Zalmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

paite: Zalmonah a pan apawt ua, Punon ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

paite: Punon a pan apawt ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apawt ua, Moab gam naih Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

paite: Ije-abarim a pan apawt ua, Dibon-gad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

paite: Dibon-gad a pan apawt ua, Almon-diblathaim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

paite: Almon-diblathaim a pan apawt ua, Nebo chin a Abarim tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

paite: Abarim tang a pan apawt ua, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Jordan gei Beth-jeshimoth a pan Abel-shittim pha in Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

paite: Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Jordan Lui Kan Ma A Kithuhilhnate
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah Jordan lui na kan ua, Kanaan gam na lut chiang un,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: huai gam a om tengteng na delhkhe vek ding ua, asuang milim tengteng uh na hihse vek ding ua, amilim sunte uh na hihse vek ding ua, amun sangte uh na hihchim vek ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

paite: Gam na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uh. Na luah ding ua gam ka hon piaksa na hi uh.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

paite: Achi dungzui bang zel in aisan in gam na luah ding ua, a-inbul deuhte gam za deuh na pe ding ua, a-inbul lou deuhte gam neu deuh na pe ding uh. Aisan apukna peuh michih a tuam ahi dia; na pi-le-pute uh chi paidan bang zel in na luah ding uhi.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

paite: Himahleh huai gam a omte na delhkhiak kei uleh na omsakte uh na mit ua ding in sutna zum leh na sa ua ding in ling bang ahi ding ua, na omna gam uah buaina ahon tun ding uhi.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atung ua hih ka tup bang na tung uah ka hih ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”
